# World Atlas

> A comprehensive reference resource for geographic information, postal standards, and state-level data across North America.

World Atlas provides authoritative geographic and administrative reference materials, with particular focus on US state classifications and postal service standards. The site aggregates information from official sources including the United States Postal Service (USPS) and postal regulatory publications.

## Key Topics

- US State Abbreviations
- Postal Codes
- ZIP Codes
- USPS Standards
- Two-Letter State Codes
- USA Reference
- State Codes Guide
- Geography Reference
- United States Postal Service
- Publication 59
- Zonal Improvement Plan
- North American Geography
- State Classification
- Postal Administration

## USA Reference Guides

- [USA States (Two-Letter Abbreviations)](https://www.worldatlas.com/geography/usa-states.html): Reference guide to US state abbreviations, postal codes, and USPS standards
